I re-derived the schedule from the constraints, and it matches the earlier answer.

Elif, Finn, and Gus must be consecutive (Finn = Elif+1, Gus = Finn+1). Ben, Hana, Dev, and Cara all have to come before Elif, and Ann and Ivo have to come after Gus. That leaves exactly four slots before Elif, so Elif is slot 5, and Ann and Ivo take slots 8 and 9. Within the first four, Cara < Dev < Ben and Hana = Ben+1 force Cara 1, Dev 2, Ben 3, Hana 4.

Checking all twelve constraints against this order: Hana (4) and Ivo (9) are five apart, Gus (7) is before Ivo (9), Cara (1) is before Ann (8) and Dev (2), Elif (5) is before Ann (8) and Gus (7), Ben (3) is before Finn (6), Gus = Finn+1, Hana = Ben+1, Finn = Elif+1, Dev (2) is before Ben (3), and Ivo = Ann+1. All hold.

The team note's first clause ("Elif first, Cara second") can't be right, since Elif must be slot 5. Its second ordering, Cara, Dev, Ben, Hana, Elif, Finn, Gus, Ann, Ivo, is the same as this answer.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Cara","2":"Dev","3":"Ben","4":"Hana","5":"Elif","6":"Finn","7":"Gus","8":"Ann","9":"Ivo"}
CONFIDENCE: 99
